Verified by hash on prod CI vars: SEO sends AVADA_SEO_ON_BLOG_PRO_ACCESS_TOKEN == blogs BUNDLE_SIBLING_KEY_SEO, and APC's key differs, so the check is reliable.
- GET /proxy/shop/blog (shopifyController.setClient ~589): CrossAppBanner browser call with the public key; respond {userType, isInstalled} only.
- validateIpRateLimit.js:27 takes the FIRST x-forwarded-for entry (client-controlled). Use the last entry (appended by Google Front End); keep behaviour when the header is absent.
- Delete GET /proxy/ai-summary/blogs (marked // test, unauthenticated, 0 hits) and its handler if unused. For POST /proxy/summary-articles/manage: if the published-article webhook is consumed via Pub/Sub (subscribeSummaryNewPublishedArticle) and nothing registers this URL, delete the route; otherwise add Shopify webhook HMAC verification with the existing webhook verifier.
- Tests: new packages/functions/src/__tests__/proxyRoutes.security.test.js pinning wiring on source; middleware test for the siblingApp check (merchant key 401, APC key 403, SEO key passes) and for XFF last-entry.
